description: Requests, PHP-FPM workers and logs of the Shellbox sidecar for one MediaWiki application. Select a model and application, then compare any of its units.

panels.description: Selected units where Shellbox's Apache or PHP-FPM is down or cannot be scraped. MediaWiki features that run commands through Shellbox, such as syntax highlighting, fail on these units.

targets.expr: count(min by (juju_model_uuid, juju_application, juju_unit) ({__name__=~"up|apache_up",container="shellbox",juju_charm="mediawiki-k8s",juju_model=~"$juju_model",juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid",juju_application=~"$juju_application",juju_unit=~"$juju_unit"}) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Units down

panels.description: Shellbox requests on the selected units in the selected time range, from the Shellbox Apache access logs. Health checks are excluded.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({juju_model=~"$juju_model", juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid", juju_application=~"$juju_application", juju_unit=~"$juju_unit", pebble_service="shellbox-apache2"} |= "request_duration_microseconds=" | logfmt | path != "/shellbox/healthz" [$__range]))

panels.title: Requests

panels.description: Shellbox requests that returned a 4xx or 5xx status in the selected time range. Health checks are excluded. Use the panel link to inspect failed requests in Logs.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({juju_model=~"$juju_model", juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid", juju_application=~"$juju_application", juju_unit=~"$juju_unit", pebble_service="shellbox-apache2"} |= "request_duration_microseconds=" | logfmt | path != "/shellbox/healthz" | status >= 400 [$__range]))

panels.title: Failed requests

panels.description: Highest per-unit 95th percentile Shellbox request duration in the selected time range, from the Shellbox Apache access logs. Health checks are excluded.

targets.expr: max(quantile_over_time(0.95, {juju_model=~"$juju_model", juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid", juju_application=~"$juju_application", juju_unit=~"$juju_unit", pebble_service="shellbox-apache2"} |= "request_duration_microseconds=" | logfmt request_duration_microseconds, path | path != "/shellbox/healthz" | unwrap request_duration_microseconds [$__range]) by (juju_model, juju_model_uuid, juju_application, juju_unit))

panels.title: p95 request duration

panels.description: Times a selected unit's PHP-FPM pool reached its configured worker limit in the selected time range, reported by PHP-FPM. This counts limit-reached events, not requests that waited. Correlate with request duration and workload distribution before scaling.
panels.title: Pool limit hits

panels.description: Shellbox status of each selected unit in this application. Apache is down if Apache or its exporter cannot be scraped. Active FPM workers includes command requests, health checks and status scrapes. Restarts and Pool limit hits cover the selected time range. Restarts count PHP-FPM uptime resets, including planned restarts.
panels.title: Units

panels.description: Whether Shellbox's Apache and PHP-FPM could be scraped on each selected unit over time. A point is Down if any scrape failed in the rolling lookback window, so it can remain Down after service recovers. Gaps mean no data, for example before a unit existed.

targets.expr: min by (juju_model, juju_model_uuid, juju_application, juju_unit) (min_over_time(up{container="shellbox",juju_charm="mediawiki-k8s",juju_model=~"$juju_model",juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid",juju_application=~"$juju_application",juju_unit=~"$juju_unit"}[$__rate_interval]) or label_replace(min_over_time(apache_up{container="shellbox",juju_charm="mediawiki-k8s",juju_model=~"$juju_model",juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid",juju_application=~"$juju_application",juju_unit=~"$juju_unit"}[$__rate_interval]), "probe", "apache", "", ""))

panels.title: Up history

panels.description: Native PHP-FPM active-process count on each selected unit. Includes command requests, health checks and status scrapes; it is not a count of running commands. Brief activity between scrapes may not be observed.
panels.title: Active PHP-FPM workers

panels.description: Increase in PHP-FPM's worker-limit-reached counter on each selected unit. Counts limit-reached events, not requests that waited. Correlate with request duration and workload distribution before scaling.
panels.title: Pool limit hits

panels.description: Shellbox requests per interval (at least one minute) by HTTP status code, from the Shellbox Apache access logs. Health checks are excluded.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (count_over_time({juju_model=~"$juju_model", juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid", juju_application=~"$juju_application", juju_unit=~"$juju_unit", pebble_service="shellbox-apache2"} |= "request_duration_microseconds=" | logfmt | path != "/shellbox/healthz" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Requests by status / $__interval

panels.description: Shellbox requests per interval (at least one minute) on each unit, from the Shellbox Apache access logs. Each unit's MediaWiki only sends requests to its own Shellbox. Health checks are excluded.

targets.expr: sum by (juju_model, juju_model_uuid, juju_application, juju_unit) (count_over_time({juju_model=~"$juju_model", juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid", juju_application=~"$juju_application", juju_unit=~"$juju_unit", pebble_service="shellbox-apache2"} |= "request_duration_microseconds=" | logfmt | path != "/shellbox/healthz" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Requests by unit / $__interval

panels.description: Share of each unit's Shellbox requests that returned a 4xx or 5xx status, per interval (at least one minute). Health checks are excluded from the ratio, but their access logs supply a zero baseline during idle intervals. Intervals without any access logs remain empty, not healthy.

targets.expr: (sum by (juju_model, juju_model_uuid, juju_application, juju_unit) (count_over_time({juju_model=~"$juju_model", juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid", juju_application=~"$juju_application", juju_unit=~"$juju_unit", pebble_service="shellbox-apache2"} |= "request_duration_microseconds=" | logfmt | path != "/shellbox/healthz" | status >= 400 [$__auto])) / sum by (juju_model, juju_model_uuid, juju_application, juju_unit) (count_over_time({juju_model=~"$juju_model", juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid", juju_application=~"$juju_application", juju_unit=~"$juju_unit", pebble_service="shellbox-apache2"} |= "request_duration_microseconds=" | logfmt | path != "/shellbox/healthz" [$__auto]))) or (sum by (juju_model, juju_model_uuid, juju_application, juju_unit) (count_over_time({juju_model=~"$juju_model", juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid", juju_application=~"$juju_application", juju_unit=~"$juju_unit", pebble_service="shellbox-apache2"} |= "request_duration_microseconds=" [$__auto])) * 0)

panels.title: Failure ratio

panels.description: Shellbox request duration percentiles for the selected application and units, per interval (at least one minute), from the Shellbox Apache access logs. Health checks are excluded.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {juju_model=~"$juju_model", juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid", juju_application=~"$juju_application", juju_unit=~"$juju_unit", pebble_service="shellbox-apache2"} |= "request_duration_microseconds=" | logfmt request_duration_microseconds, path | path != "/shellbox/healthz" | unwrap request_duration_microseconds [$__auto]) by (juju_model, juju_model_uuid, juju_application)

quantile_over_time(0.9, {juju_model=~"$juju_model", juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid", juju_application=~"$juju_application", juju_unit=~"$juju_unit", pebble_service="shellbox-apache2"} |= "request_duration_microseconds=" | logfmt request_duration_microseconds, path | path != "/shellbox/healthz" | unwrap request_duration_microseconds [$__auto]) by (juju_model, juju_model_uuid, juju_application)

quantile_over_time(0.95, {juju_model=~"$juju_model", juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid", juju_application=~"$juju_application", juju_unit=~"$juju_unit", pebble_service="shellbox-apache2"} |= "request_duration_microseconds=" | logfmt request_duration_microseconds, path | path != "/shellbox/healthz" | unwrap request_duration_microseconds [$__auto]) by (juju_model, juju_model_uuid, juju_application)

quantile_over_time(0.99, {juju_model=~"$juju_model", juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid", juju_application=~"$juju_application", juju_unit=~"$juju_unit", pebble_service="shellbox-apache2"} |= "request_duration_microseconds=" | logfmt request_duration_microseconds, path | path != "/shellbox/healthz" | unwrap request_duration_microseconds [$__auto]) by (juju_model, juju_model_uuid, juju_application)

panels.title: Request duration (percentile)

panels.description: Shellbox Apache workers in use by state, summed across the selected units. Apache passes requests to PHP-FPM, so a worker stays busy while it waits for a command to finish. The count includes the metrics scrape.
panels.title: Busy Apache workers

panels.description: Rate of HTTP requests handled by Shellbox Apache on each unit. Includes Shellbox commands, the Pebble health check and Prometheus scrapes of Apache and PHP-FPM status endpoints; use the access-log request panels for command traffic.
panels.title: Apache request rate

panels.description: Rate of response data sent by Shellbox Apache on each unit. Includes command responses and monitoring endpoints; this is not total sidecar network traffic.
panels.title: Apache sent rate

panels.description: Shellbox access log entries with a 4xx or 5xx status. Health checks are excluded.

targets.expr: {juju_model=~"$juju_model", juju_model_uuid=~"$juju_model_uuid", juju_application=~"$juju_application", juju_unit=~"$juju_unit", pebble_service="shellbox-apache2"} |= "request_duration_microseconds=" | logfmt | path != "/shellbox/healthz" | status >= 400
